scope: Authored fictional BM/English development fixture; 20 sources and 40 queries including translation pairs. Not held-out, industrial, or independent AI evidence. Do not use these fictional instructions on real equipment.

documents.content: Rhea rover battery: charge the lithium pack at the blue dock. The status indicator turns green when charging is complete. Do not charge below zero degrees Celsius.
Penapis habuk rover Rhea perlu dibersihkan setiap 40 jam operasi. Matikan kuasa sebelum membuka penutup penapis. Jangan gunakan air.
Rhea radio link recovery: hold the amber pairing button for six seconds. Reconnect to the workshop controller on channel seven.
Robot Suri mempunyai butang henti kecemasan merah di bahagian belakang. Putarkan butang mengikut arah jam untuk melepaskannya, kemudian sahkan kawasan selamat.
Suri gripper calibration uses an unloaded jaw. Open the maintenance panel, choose CAL GRIP and keep the work area empty during calibration.
Peta navigasi Suri disimpan sebagai sumber berversi. Selepas susun atur kilang berubah, imbas semula lorong dan terbitkan versi peta baharu sebelum operasi.
Nuri incubator temperature calibration uses a reference probe at 37 degrees Celsius. Wait fifteen minutes for the chamber to stabilize before recording the offset.
Penggera Nuri kod H12 menunjukkan pintu terbuka melebihi dua minit. Tutup pintu dan periksa getah pengedap sebelum mengakui penggera.
Bayu sensor firmware updates require external power and a signed update image. Keep the USB cable attached until the device reports UPDATE COMPLETE.
Penderia Bayu menyimpan 2048 bacaan terakhir dalam gelung. Apabila penuh, bacaan paling lama diganti. Eksport bacaan sebelum servis berjadual.
Mira research station backups run at 02:30 UTC. The backup archive is stored on the offline amber drive and verified with a SHA256 checksum.
Rekod eksperimen Mira disimpan selama 180 hari. Fail latihan beridentiti peserta perlu dipadam selepas tempoh persetujuan tamat.
Dara spindle lubrication uses lubricant L7 every 120 operating hours. A dry spindle may trigger vibration warning V31.
Tangki penyejuk Dara mempunyai kapasiti 12 liter. Kekalkan kepekatan penyejuk antara empat hingga enam peratus dan periksa sebelum setiap syif.
Awan field gateway can operate without internet for 72 hours. Data is queued locally and synchronized after the authenticated uplink is restored.
Kunci akses Awan ditukar setiap 30 hari. Gunakan port servis setempat dan sahkan identiti peranti sebelum memasang kunci baharu.
Luma image classification model revision 8 expects RGB images resized to 224 by 224 pixels. Apply pixel normalization version two before inference.
Model embedding Luma teks-v3 menghasilkan vektor 384 dimensi. Dokumen dan pertanyaan mesti menggunakan versi model serta tokenisasi yang sama.
Tala logger factory reset erases all local samples. Export the samples first, disconnect the probe and hold RESET for ten seconds.
Jam Tala menggunakan UTC. Jika perbezaan masa melebihi lima saat, selaraskan dengan pelayan masa dalaman sebelum memulakan eksperimen baharu.
